taxonomy_name: VibeCraft AI Slope Deterministic Rule Taxonomy

rule_types.description: Objective, measurable requirement backed by authoritative standard (e.g. WCAG 44pt touch target). Triggers BLOCK / ERROR.
Applies only in specific defined platform/device context (e.g. visionOS 60pt center spacing).
Checks proper UI pattern scaffold implementation (e.g. Doherty skeleton loader).
Enforces UI consistency across related elements.
Uses explicit mathematical formula (e.g. R_inner = max(0, R_outer - Padding), WCAG contrast ratio).

precedence_hierarchy: 2. Platform / System Hard Requirement (Apple HIG OS Constraints)
3. Hard Geometric & Mathematical Constraint (Concentric Radius, Spatial Grid)
